children.name: Truncatella californica L.Pfeiffer, 1857
children.description: Truncatella californica, common name of the Californian truncatella, is a species of very small amphibious (between sea and land) snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Truncatellidae.

children.name: Truncatella caribaeensis Reeve, 1842
children.description: Truncatella caribaeensis is a species of a very small somewhat amphibious land snail with a gill and an operculum, a semi-terrestrial gastropod mollusk or micromollusk in the family Truncatellidae, the truncatella snails or looping snails.

children.name: Truncatella guerinii A.Villa & J.B.Villa, 1841
children.description: Truncatella guerinii is a species of very small land snail that lives at the edge of the sea, a gastropod mollusk in the family Truncatellidae.

children.name: Truncatella marginata Küster, 1855
children.description: Truncatella marginata is a species of a very small somewhat amphibious land snail with a gill and an operculum, a semi-terrestrial gastropod mollusk or micromollusk in the family Truncatellidae, the truncatella snails or looping snails.

children.name: Truncatella pulchella L.Pfeiffer, 1839

children.name: Truncatella scalarina J.C.Cox, 1867
children.description: Truncatella scalarina is a species of very small land snail that lives next to seawater, a gastropod mollusk or micromollusk in the family Truncatellidae.
